note: Stats in the story's voice. Each stat has ordered bands; a band covers values up to and including upTo (the last band has no upTo). Forms: say (a clause for mid sentence: {voice("hunger")}), short (one or two words: {voice("hunger", "short")}), status (a full sentence for the menu). id is used in conditions: ?if band("hunger") == "starving". hidden stats never appear in the menu. Write from the hero's side, in second person, without gendered words.

bands.say: your hunger lies quiet
bands.status: You are fed. The hunger sleeps, for now.

bands.say: your hunger stirs
bands.status: The hunger stirs at the back of your throat.

bands.say: your hunger gnaws at you
bands.status: Hunger gnaws at you. Every heartbeat in the room is loud.

bands.say: your hunger claws at your thoughts
bands.status: You are starving. It is getting hard to think of anything but blood.

bands.say: your hunger is a roaring thing that wants control
bands.status: The hunger is close to taking you. Feed, or it will choose for you.

bands.say: little of the person you were remains
bands.status: When you look for the person you were, you find almost nothing.

bands.say: you feel colder than the grave
bands.status: Mortal grief and joy reach you from far away, like voices through a wall.

bands.say: your humanity is fraying
bands.status: You still feel for the living, but it takes effort now.

bands.say: you still remember what it is to be mortal
bands.status: You remember what it is to be mortal, and you hold on to it.

bands.say: your heart is as human as it ever was
bands.status: Whatever you have become, your heart is still your own.

bands.say: you are patience and misdirection to the bone
bands.status: Others call you a spider. You have never had to raise your voice.

bands.say: you favor the knife in the dark over the open blow
bands.status: You prefer to win before the fight begins.

bands.say: no one can say yet whether you are the fox or the wolf
bands.status: You are neither fox nor wolf yet, and that keeps enemies guessing.

bands.say: you settle things with strength and fear
bands.status: People step aside when you enter a room, and they are right to.

bands.say: your name is spoken the way people speak of plague
bands.status: Your reputation does your killing for you now.

bands.say: you are barely more than newly turned
bands.status: You are new to the night, and every elder can smell it on you.

bands.say: you are young as your kind count years
bands.status: You are young as your kind count years, strong but not yet feared.

bands.say: the weight of centuries sits on you
bands.status: Centuries sit on you. Younger vampires feel it when you enter a room.

bands.say: you are ancient, older than most kingdoms
bands.status: You are ancient. Few still walk who are older than you.

bands.say: you are among the eldest things that walk the night
bands.status: You are among the eldest of your kind, and the night knows it.

bands.say: your purse is thin
bands.status: Your purse is thin. Collis is a name and little more.

bands.say: you have money enough to be careless with it
bands.status: Collis keeps you comfortable, with a little set aside.

bands.say: your coffers are deep
bands.status: Collis is rich, and its name opens doors.

bands.say: you command a fortune
bands.status: Collis commands a fortune that bankers whisper about.

bands.say: your wealth could buy a crown
bands.status: Your fortune could buy a crown, and some say it already has.

bands.say: Collesanto barely holds on
bands.status: Collesanto is a handful of houses on a hill, barely holding on.

bands.say: Collesanto gets by
bands.status: Collesanto gets by: a well, a chapel, fields that feed it.

bands.say: Collesanto thrives
bands.status: Collesanto thrives. Travelers stop there on purpose now.

bands.say: Collesanto has grown proud and prosperous
bands.status: Collesanto is a proud little town that owes you more than it knows.

bands.say: Collesanto shines like a jewel in the hills
bands.status: Collesanto is the jewel of its hills, and it has your protection in its bones.

bands.say: too many eyes have found you
bands.status: Too many people know your face. Someone is coming.

bands.say: you are being watched
bands.status: You are being watched. You feel it in the street like a draft.

bands.say: rumors follow you
bands.status: There are rumors. Nothing that can be proven, yet.

bands.say: you move unseen
bands.status: You move unseen. The rumors that exist point elsewhere.

bands.say: you are a ghost to the world
bands.status: You are a ghost. Even your enemies are not sure you exist.

bands.say: the covens treat you as an outcast
bands.status: The covens shut their doors to you. Some would pay to see you burn.

bands.say: other vampires distrust you
bands.status: Other vampires watch you with open distrust.

bands.say: your name means little among the covens
bands.status: Among the covens your name means little, for good or ill.

bands.say: the covens respect you
bands.status: The covens respect you, and some seek your favor.

bands.say: your name carries weight in every haven
bands.status: Your name carries weight in every haven, and elders choose their words with you.

bands.say: the Velati hunt you
bands.status: The Velati have marked you as a threat to be ended.

bands.say: the Velati count you a danger
bands.status: The Velati count you a danger and keep a thick file.

bands.say: the Velati barely know your name
bands.status: If the Velati know of you, they have not decided what you are.

bands.say: the Velati are curious about you
bands.status: The Velati are curious. They watch, but they do not strike.

bands.say: the Velati treat you as an uneasy ally
bands.status: Some among the Velati treat you as an uneasy ally.

bands.say: something old in your blood is quiet
bands.status: Something old in your blood is quiet.

bands.say: something in your blood bristles at the order of things
bands.status: Something in your blood bristles at the order of things.

bands.say: your blood burns against every throne and chain
bands.status: Your blood burns against every throne and chain.

bands.say: this century baffles you
bands.status: This century baffles you, and everyone can tell.

bands.say: you are catching up with the times
bands.status: You are catching up with the times, mostly.

bands.say: you move through this age like a native
bands.status: You move through this age like a native, old habits aside.

bands.say: their loyalty is gone
bands.status: Their loyalty is gone.

bands.say: their loyalty wavers
bands.status: Their loyalty wavers.

bands.say: they are loyal to you
bands.status: They are loyal to you.

bands.say: they would die for you
bands.status: They would die for you.

bands.say: there is only bitterness between you
bands.status: There is only bitterness between you.

bands.say: things are cool between you
bands.status: Things are cool between you.

bands.say: you are still finding each other out
bands.status: You are still finding each other out.

bands.say: you have grown close
bands.status: You have grown close.

bands.say: you are bound to each other
bands.status: You are bound to each other.
